claims.head: Who blinks first?
claims.body: The Wild are near the top of the league for shot volume, but the Mammoth are one of the best at keeping shots away. Our lean: the Mammoth hold the line.

claims.head: The Mammoth roll four lines, the Wild lean on their top six
claims.body: On depth, Utah is the league’s best, but Minnesota is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. If this one comes down to the bottom six, that suits the Mammoth.

notes.text: Marcus Foligno is on injured reserve and has missed the last 7 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Maxim Shabanov is day to day (upper-body injury) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Brock Faber is on injured reserve (skull surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Jonas Brodin has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes.
Tyler Pitlick was added to the roster on Oct 13 and has played beside Michael McCarron and Rieger Lorenz.
John Marino is day to day (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Andrew Peeke has taken his spot beside Nate Schmidt.

UTA.head: Leaning the Mammoth’s way
UTA.body: Utah may be without Marino, but they have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. The Wild can still swing it if their power play gets going.

MIN.head: Close, but the Mammoth have the slight edge
MIN.body: Utah may be without Marino, but they have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. The Wild’s best way to tip it is a power play that gets going.

story.head: Who blinks first?
paras: The Wild come in at 6-3-2, the Mammoth at 7-4-0.

It’s strength against strength: the Wild are near the top of the league for shot volume, but the Mammoth are one of the best at keeping shots away. The Mammoth roll four lines, but the Wild lean on their top six.

items.text: The Wild are newly without Maxim Shabanov, have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start.
Vincent Trocheck has a point in five straight games against Minnesota, with a goal in each of the last four.
The Mammoth are newly without John Marino.
